signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Gettokeniseerde beursvenue in Canton mogelijk eerst onder SEC-kader voor handel
signals.summary: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: USDT komt naar Bitcoin met privacyfuncties en snellere betalingen
signals.summary: USDT is coming home to Bitcoin, offering privacy and Lightning-fast payments. But can Bitcoin’s revamped version of Tether compete with stablecoins on ETH and TRON?

signals.title: BlackRock, SBI en Startale onderzoeken koppeling gettokeniseerde geldmarktfondsen met JPYSC
signals.summary: BlackRock, SBI Holdings, and Startale will explore connecting tokenized money market funds with SBI's Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin JPYSC.

signals.title: ECB-president Lagarde treedt op 7 februari 2027 af
signals.summary: ECB President Lagarde to step down on 7 February 2027

signals.title: EBA adviseert op vereenvoudiging Taxonomie-informatievoorschriften
signals.summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published its response to the European Commission’s Call for Technical Advice on certain key performance indicators (KPIs) and other aspects of the Disclosures Delegated Act under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation. The EBA advises on targeted changes to streamline disclosure requirements, reduce complexity and enhance the usability of information disclosed by credit institutions and investment firms.
